snippet.title: The Defiant - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Defiant is a cinematic, high-intensity FPS game set in the Eastern Front of World War II, where players take on the role of resistance fighters battling Japanese invaders across fractured frontlines in China, delivering battlefield immersion, tactical gunplay, gritty realism, and character-driven storytelling.

We are the Defiant.
